blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX flipped the switch in the second half and pummeled Titan Ultra into oblivion with a 147-115 victory to close in on the top seed in Group A of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Wednesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Import Deonte Burton had 21 points, nine rebounds, seven assists, three steals and two blocks while Robert Bolick posted 20 points, five rebounds and eight assists as the Road Warriors improved to a 9-2 win-loss record. But NLEX needed a wake-up call after being held to a 65-all tie with the lowly Titan Ultra side at the half. Coach Jimmy […]...
